name: EasyCard NG Payment Gateway on WooCommerce
author: Ecng

sections.description:
EasyCard is one of Israel’s leading payment gateway.
Our plugin enables you to accept all credit card types, as well as Bit payments.
Built in support for multiple currencies.

Easy Integration

Connecting EasyCard plugin with your WooCommerce store takes just a few simple steps.

Key Features

  • Credit Card Payment
  • Bit Payment
  • Integration with Israeli invoicing systems
  • Multi currency support
  • Webhook Support: Use webhooks to handle real-time payment notifications. Webhook URL: /wc-api/ecng_webhook. Follow the detailed setup guide here.

2.3.1

  • Added new iframe attribute allow="payment" to support ECNG payment page requirements.

2.3

  • Fixed SSL issue for secure payment processing.

2.2

  • Added new option: Payment Button Text in the plugin settings.

2.1

  • Integrated webhook functionality.
  • Webhook URL: https://example.com/wc-api/ecng_webhook.
  • Follow the steps outlined in the EasycardNG Webhook Guide for implementation details.

2.0.2

  • Compatible with product code

2.0.1

  • Compatible with PHP 8.2+
  • Compatible with Latest WordPress version 6.4.2
  • Compatible with latest WooCommerce version 8.4.0

2.0.0

  • Bug fixing.

1.0.1

  • Added the DealType Field Selectbox in the Payment Gateway Setting Form.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
